questions.question: Select the number that will come in the place of the question mark(?), if '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged 61 − 42 × 6 ÷ 9 + 27 = ?
questions.questionHtml:
Select the number that will come in the place of the question mark(?), if '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged
61 − 42 × 6 ÷ 9 + 27 = ?
questions.solution:
Given equation: 61 − 42 × 6 ÷ 9 + 27 = ?

After interchanging the signs then:

⇒ 61 + 42 ÷ 6 × 9 - 27 = ? ⇒ ? = 61 + 7 × 9 - 27 ⇒ ? = 61 + 63 - 27 = 124 - 27 = 97

questions.question: What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if ‘÷’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘+’ are interchanged? 2 × 16 ÷ 36 + 42 − 6 = ?
questions.questionHtml:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if ‘÷’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘+’ are interchanged?

2 × 16 ÷ 36 + 42 − 6 = ?
questions.solution:
Given equation: 2 × 16 ÷ 36 + 42 − 6 = ?

After interchanging the signs then:

⇒ 2 + 16 - 36 × 42 ÷ 6 = ? ⇒ ? = 2 + 16 - 36 × 7 ⇒ ? = 2 + 16 - 252 ⇒ ? = 18 - 252 ⇒ ? = -234

questions.question: In a certain code language, A + B means ‘A is the husband of B’, A − B means ‘B is the mother of A’, A × B means ‘B is the sister of A’ and A ÷ B means ‘A is the daughter of B’. Based on the above, how is Q related to T if ‘P + Q × R ÷ S ÷ T’?
questions.questionHtml:
In a certain code language,
A + B means ‘A is the husband of B’,
A − B means ‘B is the mother of A’,
A × B means ‘B is the sister of A’ and
A ÷ B means ‘A is the daughter of B’.
Based on the above, how is Q related to T if ‘P + Q × R ÷ S ÷ T’?
questions.solution:
P is the husband of Q, R is the sister of Q, S is the mother of R and S is the daughter of T.

So, Q is the "Daughter’s daughter" of T.
